messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout initiated for service=embedder, version=rl-embed-v3 -> starting gradual shift to 15% in ap-southeast-1. Watching 10m windows.
Maya: seeing a small spike in 502/503s on the embedder aggregator around 1717804400, correlated with long tail on batch requests.
alex: can you paste the quick metrics? p99 and error rate?
ellen_sre: p99 token latency up ~120ms (baseline ~45ms). 5xx rate went from 0.1% -> 1.2% on that region, starts at ~1717804385. logs show `kvcache evict` churn.
ops_jordan: hmm that aligns with the new qcache kernel change in rl-embed-v3. we should probably hold and pin traffic back to stable.
li: agree. recommend stop rollout and pin version to rl-embed-v2 for ap-southeast-1 while we investigate.
Maya: +1 to pin. any quick mitigation other than rollback? can we toggle cache settings?
ellen_sre: we can flip kvcache size to previous value but that's a config change and slower. revert seems fastest.
alex: ok let's run rollback for that region. ops_jordan do you want me to run the rollback or should we use deploybot?
ops_jordan: use deploybot so we have audit trail. run: `/deploy rollback --service embedder --region ap-southeast-1 --to rl-embed-v2 --reason="canary 5xx spike"`
Maya: sending now. :rocket:
deploybot: Command received: `/deploy rollback --service embedder --region ap-southeast-1 --to rl-embed-v2 --reason="canary 5xx spike"`. Proceeding with 3-phase rollback: drain -> switch -> verify. ETA ~4m.
ellen_sre: copying verification checks: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/embedder?orgId=1 (watching 5xx, p99 latency, kvcache evict rate)
Maya: quick sanity check: do we need to pin routing policy to block future canaries to ap-southeast-1 for 24h?
li: yes please. ops_jordan can you set `rollout.blocklist[ap-southeast-1]=true` in the routing policy for 24h?
ops_jordan: will do after rollback completes.
alex: rollback progressing, deploybot logs: `phase=drain nodes=8/8`, `switch=complete`, `healthchecks=ok`
deploybot: Rollback complete in ap-southeast-1. Traffic back to rl-embed-v2. Notifying on-call SRE.
ellen_sre: post-rollback metrics look back to baseline within 60s, 5xx down to 0.12%, p99 back to ~50ms.
Maya: thanks everyone. We'll hold the global staged rollout until research team confirms qkernel change safe.
li: creating a follow-up task: ENG-ISSUE-1482 with logs & reproducer. tagging runtime and ml-infra.
alex: any release notes or customer-facing impact we need to draft? ops_jordan: no customer impact observed (internal canary). I'll add a short note in the release tracker.
Maya: closing this thread once blocklist set. ops_jordan?
ops_jordan: blocklist set for 24h and alerting rule created to catch similar kv-cache churn. :lock:
Maya: :thumbsup: thanks all.
__note: This file contains a single Slack thread as a continuous string; messages prefixed by sender names.
